stem: Lignin and suberin are polymers that are present in plant tissues.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe **and** explain the roles of lignin and suberin in the transport of water through the roots and stem of a plant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The enzyme laccase catalyses the formation of lignin in plants.

Fig. 4.1 is a diagram of the mode of action of laccase.

{{figure:figure_4_1.webp}}

Describe **and** explain the mode of action of laccase when catalysing the formation of lignin.
